gate_results.name: rule_compliance
gate_results.rationale: TRAIN-only offline teacher imitation produces no candidate package or current official-site validation.

gate_results.name: mechanism_activation
gate_results.rationale: Exact source report and NPZ hashes matched; the fixed ridge and nine-neighbor visual models fit whole TRAIN cells and produced finite held-cell predictions.

gate_results.name: competitive_or_product_outcome
gate_results.rationale: Neither learned model met preregistered natural full-sequence sign accuracy. Ridge achieved 16/30 and nearest nine 16/30; fixed first-direction hold 22/30, below 75%. No student driving is authorized by this gate.
